archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) optimized for UAE Corporate Finance with Luxury Trust Accents

primary.description: Axistra Green - Used for Sidebar, primary buttons, and key highlights.

accent.description: Axistra Gold - Used for active states, premium indicators, and CTA accents.

background.description: Slightly green-tinted off-white for main content background to soften contrast and look premium.

surface.description: Pure white for cards, panels, and dropdowns.

hierarchy.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-gray-500
hierarchy.hash: text-sm font-mono text-gray-600 bg-gray-100 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-gray-200

layout.global: LIGHT THEME ONLY. Do not apply dark mode classes for anything other than specific inverse sections like the sidebar.
layout.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen w-64 bg-[#0A5C3E] text-white flex flex-col z-50 border-r border-[#117852]
layout.spacing_system: Professional generous padding. p-6 or p-8 for large cards. Use gap-4 for related data elements.

components.cards: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200. Internal padding MUST be p-6.

buttons.primary: bg-[#0A5C3E] text-white hover:bg-[#084a32] px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D4AF37] focus:outline-none
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#D4AF37] text-white hover:bg-[#b8962c] px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-colors

components.tables: w-full text-left text-sm text-gray-600. Headers must be bg-gray-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 font-semibold p-4. Cells p-4 border-b border-gray-100.
components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border
components.audit_stepper: Horizontal flex container. Steps connected by absolute positioned 2px line (bg-gray-200). Active lines bg-[#0A5C3E]. Nodes: w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center border-2 border-[#0A5C3E] bg-white z-10 font-bold.
components.inputs: bg-white border border-gray-300 text-gray-900 text-sm rounded-md focus:ring-[#0A5C3E] focus:border-[#0A5C3E] block w-full p-2.5 shadow-sm

icons.instruction: Use Phosphor icons. Use 'duotone' weight for major navigational items or dashboard visual interest. Use 'regular' for dense tables and small buttons.

logos.description: Axistra Technologies Shield and Wordmark. To be used in the top of the dark green sidebar and login screen.
Alternate Axistra Logo. Use when a lighter or alternative context is needed (e.g., printed invoices/PDFs).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME CONSTRAINT: Implement a strictly LIGHT THEME interface. Dark mode logic should be removed/omitted. The background should be a very subtle warm gray/green (#F8F9F7).
2. BRANDING: Anchor the application with the Axistra Green (#0A5C3E) sidebar and primary actions. Use Axistra Gold (#D4AF37) for highlights, active sidebar states, and premium CTAs.
3. TYPOGRAPHY: Include Google Fonts/Fontshare links for Cabinet Grotesk (Headings), IBM Plex Sans (Body), and IBM Plex Mono (for Crypto TX hashes/IDs). Avoid Inter/Roboto entirely.

4. AUDIT CHAIN STEPPER: The Recharges detail page MUST have a horizontal stepper visualization (Customer -> Invoice -> Crypto TX Hash -> Magnus Credit -> OKX -> Wio Bank). This is the 'hero' element of the page. Make it structural, indisputable, and clear.
5. DATA DISPLAY: Present Crypto TX Hashes, Invoice IDs, and Recharges with mono-spaced fonts. Provide 1-click 'Copy' buttons (using Phosphor Copy icon) next to all hashes and IDs.

6. TABLES & FILTERS: Build robust table components with Shadcn (customized to remove generic Vercel looks) for Customers, Recharges, and Compliance Logs. Add clear search and filter inputs above tables.
7. EXPORTS: Use secondary buttons for PDF/CSV/Excel exports with distinct icons (FilePdf, FileCsv).

8. TESTING ATTRIBUTES: It is CRITICAL to apply kebab-case `data-testid` attributes to every single button, form input, table row, and navigational link (e.g., `data-testid="export-pdf-btn"`, `data-testid="sidebar-nav-invoices"`).
9. ICONS: Utilize @phosphor-icons/react. Ensure professional, geometric icon representation fitting a finance and compliance auditing tool.
